aml_alert_action.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Recommended action from the total score produced by aml_transaction_monitoring; score bands are invented for illustration","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"aml_alert_action","inputs":{"hasLargeCash":"bool","riskScore":"int"},"outputs":{"action":"string","fileCtr":"bool"},"rules":[{"description":"Prepare a suspicious transaction report for the compliance officer; a large cash transaction is reported as well","id":"FILE_STR","reasonCode":"SUSPICION_SCORE_HIGH","then":{"action":"'FILE_STR'","fileCtr":"hasLargeCash"},"when":"riskScore >= 70"},{"id":"ANALYST_REVIEW","reasonCode":"SUSPICION_SCORE_ELEVATED","then":{"action":"'ANALYST_REVIEW'","fileCtr":"hasLargeCash"},"when":"riskScore >= 30"},{"description":"Large cash transaction without other suspicion: the large-value report only","id":"FILE_CTR_ONLY","reasonCode":"LARGE_CASH_REPORTABLE","then":{"action":"'FILE_CTR_ONLY'","fileCtr":"true"},"when":"hasLargeCash"},{"id":"NO_ACTION","then":{"action":"'NO_ACTION'","fileCtr":"false"},"when":"true"}],"version":"1"}

aml_name_screening.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Screens a customer against a sanctions and PEP watchlist by name, aliases and date of birth; thresholds are invented for illustration","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"aml_name_screening","inputs":{"customer":{"aliases":["string"],"dateOfBirth":"date","fullName":"string","nationality":"string"},"watchlist":[{"aliases":["string"],"dateOfBirth":"date","listType":"string","name":"string"}]},"outputs":{"bestScore":"decimal","result":"string"},"rules":[{"description":"A missing or blank name cannot be screened; scores of 0.92 or more were caught above","id":"SANCTIONS_WEAK_MATCH","reasonCode":"SANCTIONS_WEAK_MATCH","then":{"bestScore":"maxNameSimilarity(customer.fullName, watchlist.map(w, w.name))","result":"'REVIEW'"},"when":"watchlist.exists(w, w.listType == 'SANCTIONS' && ([customer.fullName] + customer.aliases).exists(n, normalizeName(n) != '' && maxNameSimilarity(n, [w.name] + w.aliases) >= decimal('0.85')))"},{"description":"Name or alias scores 0.92 or more against a politically exposed person; aml_transaction_monitoring.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"AML alerts for a transaction and the account's recent activity; the application sums the scores and passes them to aml_alert_action. Amounts in VND; thresholds are invented for illustration","hitPolicy":"COLLECT","id":"aml_transaction_monitoring","inputs":{"account":{"customerIsPep":"bool","lastActivityBeforeToday":"date","openedOn":"date","riskRating":"string"},"history":{"cashDepositsLast7d":["money"],"totalInLast24h":"money","totalOutLast24h":"money"},"transaction":{"amount":"money","counterpartyCountry":"string","type":"string","valueDate":"date"}},"outputs":{"alert":"string","score":"int"},"rules":[{"description":"Cash deposit or withdrawal at or above the (invented) reporting threshold of 300,000,000 VND","id":"LARGE_CASH","reasonCode":"LARGE_CASH_TRANSACTION","then":{"alert":"'LARGE_CASH'","score":"10"},"when":"transaction.type in ['CASH_DEPOSIT', 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'] && transaction.amount >= money(300000000, 'VND')"},{"description":"3 or more cash deposits in 7 days, each from 80% of the reporting threshold up to just below it; history includes this transaction","id":"STRUCTURING","reasonCode":"POSSIBLE_STRUCTURING","then":{"alert":"'STRUCTURING'","score":"50"},"when":"history.cashDepositsLast7d.filter(d, d >= money(300000000, 'VND') * decimal('0.8') && d < money(300000000, 'VND')).size() >= 3"},{"description":"Money out within 24 hours is 90% or more of money in, above a minimum inflow of 500,000,000 VND (100,000,000 VND for high-risk customers)","id":"RAPID_IN_OUT","reasonCode":"RAPID_MOVEMENT_OF_FUNDS","then":{"alert":"'RAPID_IN_OUT'","score":"40"},"when":"history.totalInLast24h >= (account.riskRating == 'HIGH' ? money(100000000, 'VND') : money(500000000, 'VND')) && history.totalOutLast24h >= history.totalInLast24h * decimal('0.9')"},{"description":"Counterparty in a high-risk jurisdiction; XA, XB and XC are placeholders for your institution's list","id":"HIGH_RISK_COUNTRY","reasonCode":"HIGH_RISK_JURISDICTION","then":{"alert":"'HIGH_RISK_COUNTRY'","score":"30"},"when":"has(transaction.counterpartyCountry) && transaction.counterpartyCountry in ['XA', 'XB', 'XC']"},{"description":"No activity for 365 days or more before the business date (since opening if never active) and an inflow of 100,000,000 VND or more","id":"DORMANT_REACTIVATED","reasonCode":"DORMANT_ACCOUNT_REACTIVATED","then":{"alert":"'DORMANT_ACCOUNT'","score":"30"},"when":"daysBetween(has(account.lastActivityBeforeToday) ? account.lastActivityBeforeToday : account.openedOn, businessDate) >= 365 && transaction.type in ['CASH_DEPOSIT', 'TRANSFER_IN'] && transaction.amount >= money(100000000, 'VND')"},{"description":"Transfer of 200,000,000 VND or more on an account less than 30 days old on the value date","id":"NEW_ACCOUNT_LARGE_TRANSFER","reasonCode":"NEW_ACCOUNT_LARGE_TRANSFER","then":{"alert":"'NEW_ACCOUNT_LARGE_TRANSFER'","score":"25"},"when":"daysBetween(account.openedOn, transaction.valueDate) < 30 && transaction.type in ['TRANSFER_IN', 'TRANSFER_OUT'] && transaction.amount >= money(200000000, 'VND')"},{"description":"Politically exposed customer moving 500,000,000 VND or more","id":"PEP_LARGE_TRANSACTION","reasonCode":"PEP_LARGE_TRANSACTION","then":{"alert":"'PEP_LARGE_TRANSACTION'","score":"20"},"when":"account.customerIsPep && transaction.amount >= money(500000000, 'VND')"}],"version":"1"}

card_fraud_action.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Authorization action from the risk score produced by card_fraud_signals","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"card_fraud_action","inputs":{"riskScore":"int","transaction":{"amount":"decimal","channel":"string"}},"outputs":{"action":"string"},"rules":[{"id":"DECLINE_VERY_HIGH","reasonCode":"RISK_SCORE_VERY_HIGH","then":{"action":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"riskScore >= 80"},{"description":"Only e-commerce can step up with an OTP; at POS and ATM a high score declines","id":"DECLINE_NO_STEP_UP","reasonCode":"STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE","then":{"action":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"riskScore >= 40 && transaction.channel != 'ECOM'"},{"id":"CHALLENGE_HIGH","reasonCode":"RISK_SCORE_HIGH","then":{"action":"'CHALLENGE'"},"when":"riskScore >= 40"},{"description":"Some risk on a large e-commerce payment","id":"CHALLENGE_LARGE_AMOUNT","reasonCode":"LARGE_AMOUNT_WITH_RISK","then":{"action":"'CHALLENGE'"},"when":"transaction.channel == 'ECOM' && riskScore >= 20 && transaction.amount >= 20000000"},{"id":"APPROVE","then":{"action":"'APPROVE'"},"when":"true"}],"version":"1"}

consumer_loan_conditions.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Conditions attached to an approved consumer loan; riskGrade comes from consumer_loan_underwriting","hitPolicy":"COLLECT","id":"consumer_loan_conditions","inputs":{"applicant":{"employmentType":"string"},"loan":{"amount":"decimal","collateralValue":"decimal","purpose":"string","termMonths":"int"},"riskGrade":"string"},"outputs":{"condition":"string"},"rules":[{"description":"Salary paid into an account at the bank, lower grades only","id":"SALARY_ASSIGNMENT","then":{"condition":"'SALARY_ASSIGNMENT'"},"when":"applicant.employmentType == 'SALARIED' && riskGrade in ['C', 'D']"},{"id":"TAX_RETURNS","then":{"condition":"'TAX_RETURNS_2Y'"},"when":"applicant.employmentType == 'SELF_EMPLOYED'"},{"id":"GUARANTOR","then":{"condition":"'GUARANTOR'"},"when":"riskGrade == 'D' || (!has(loan.collateralValue) && loan.amount > 500000000)"},{"id":"CREDIT_LIFE_INSURANCE","then":{"condition":"'CREDIT_LIFE_INSURANCE'"},"when":"loan.amount >= 100000000 || loan.termMonths > 36"},{"id":"COLLATERAL_INSURANCE","then":{"condition":"'COLLATERAL_INSURANCE'"},"when":"has(loan.collateralValue)"},{"id":"HOLD_VEHICLE_REGISTRATION","then":{"condition":"'HOLD_VEHICLE_REGISTRATION'"},"when":"loan.purpose == 'VEHICLE' && has(loan.collateralValue)"},{"id":"DISBURSE_TO_SCHOOL","then":{"condition":"'DISBURSE_TO_SCHOOL'"},"when":"loan.purpose == 'EDUCATION'"}],"version":"1"}

consumer_loan_underwriting.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Consumer loan underwriting: hard declines, referrals to an underwriter, approval by risk grade. Omit loan.collateralValue for an unsecured loan. Estimated instalment = amount * (1 + 1% * termMonths) / termMonths.","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"consumer_loan_underwriting","inputs":{"applicant":{"age":"int","creditScore":"int","employmentMonths":"int","employmentType":"string","existingMonthlyDebt":"decimal","hasBadDebtLast5y":"bool","monthlyIncome":"decimal"},"loan":{"amount":"decimal","collateralValue":"decimal","purpose":"string","termMonths":"int"}},"outputs":{"decision":"string","interestRate":"decimal","maxAmount":"decimal","riskGrade":"string"},"rules":[{"id":"DECLINE_AGE","reasonCode":"AGE_OUT_OF_RANGE","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"applicant.age < 20 || applicant.age > 65"},{"description":"Bad debt (credit bureau group 3 to 5) in the last 5 years","id":"DECLINE_BAD_DEBT","reasonCode":"BAD_DEBT_HISTORY","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"applicant.hasBadDebtLast5y"},{"id":"DECLINE_SCORE","reasonCode":"CREDIT_SCORE_TOO_LOW","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"applicant.creditScore < 500"},{"description":"Minimum income; also guarantees monthlyIncome > 0 for the ratios below","id":"DECLINE_INCOME","reasonCode":"INCOME_BELOW_MINIMUM","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"applicant.monthlyIncome < 5000000"},{"description":"6 to 60 months unsecured, 6 to 84 months secured; also guarantees termMonths > 0","id":"DECLINE_TERM","reasonCode":"TERM_OUT_OF_RANGE","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"loan.termMonths < 6 || loan.termMonths > (has(loan.collateralValue) ? 84 : 60)"},{"description":"Debt-to-income above 60%, including the new loan's estimated instalment","id":"DECLINE_DTI","reasonCode":"DTI_TOO_HIGH","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths > applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.6')"},{"description":"Loan-to-value above 85%","id":"DECLINE_LTV","reasonCode":"LTV_TOO_HIGH","then":{"decision":"'DECLINE'"},"when":"has(loan.collateralValue) && loan.amount > loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.85')"},{"description":"Debt-to-income above 45%","id":"REFER_DTI","reasonCode":"DTI_ELEVATED","then":{"decision":"'REFER'"},"when":"applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths > applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45')"},{"description":"Loan-to-value above 70%","id":"REFER_LTV","reasonCode":"LTV_ELEVATED","then":{"decision":"'REFER'"},"when":"has(loan.collateralValue) && loan.amount > loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')"},{"description":"Less than 12 months in the current job, or 24 months for the self-employed","id":"REFER_EMPLOYMENT","reasonCode":"EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY_SHORT","then":{"decision":"'REFER'"},"when":"applicant.employmentMonths < (applicant.employmentType == 'SELF_EMPLOYED' ? 24 : 12)"},{"id":"REFER_PURPOSE","reasonCode":"PURPOSE_NOT_STANDARD","then":{"decision":"'REFER'"},"when":"!(loan.purpose in ['CONSUMER', 'EDUCATION', 'HOME_IMPROVEMENT', 'VEHICLE'])"},{"description":"Base rate 8.5%; rate adds 5% x DTI and takes 2% off when secured; limit keeps DTI within 45% and LTV within 70%","id":"APPROVE_A","then":{"decision":"'APPROVE'","interestRate":"(decimal('0.085') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - (has(loan.collateralValue) ? decimal('0.02') : decimal(0))).round(4, 'HALF_UP')","maxAmount":"((has(loan.collateralValue) ? min((applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths), loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')) : (applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths)) / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000","riskGrade":"'A'"},"when":"applicant.creditScore >= 750 && applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths <= applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.3')"},{"description":"Base rate 10.5%","id":"APPROVE_B","then":{"decision":"'APPROVE'","interestRate":"(decimal('0.105') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - (has(loan.collateralValue) ? decimal('0.02') : decimal(0))).round(4, 'HALF_UP')","maxAmount":"((has(loan.collateralValue) ? min((applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths), loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')) : (applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths)) / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000","riskGrade":"'B'"},"when":"applicant.creditScore >= 680"},{"description":"Base rate 13%","id":"APPROVE_C","then":{"decision":"'APPROVE'","interestRate":"(decimal('0.13') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - (has(loan.collateralValue) ? credit_limit_increase.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Credit card limit increase: debt-to-income from existing loans, computed once in let and shared by the rules","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"credit_limit_increase","inputs":{"applicant":{"missedPayments12m":"int","monthlyIncome":"money"},"loans":[{"monthlyPayment":"money","outstanding":"money","type":"string"}],"requestedLimit":"money"},"let":{"affordableLimit":"(applicant.monthlyIncome * 3 - monthlyDebt).round()","dti":"monthlyDebt.amount() / applicant.monthlyIncome.amount()","monthlyDebt":"loans.map(l, l.monthlyPayment).sum(money(0, 'VND'))","unsecured":"loans.filter(l, l.type != 'MORTGAGE').map(l, l.outstanding).sum(money(0, 'VND'))"},"outputs":{"decision":"string","maxLimit":"money"},"rules":[{"id":"MISSED_PAYMENTS","reasonCode":"MISSED_PAYMENTS","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.missedPayments12m > 0"},{"id":"DTI_HIGH","reasonCode":"DTI_HIGH","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"dti > decimal('0.5')"},{"id":"UNSECURED_HIGH","reasonCode":"UNSECURED_DEBT_HIGH","then":{"decision":"'REFER'"},"when":"unsecured > applicant.monthlyIncome * 12"},{"id":"WITHIN_LIMIT","then":{"decision":"'APPROVE'","maxLimit":"requestedLimit"},"when":"requestedLimit <= affordableLimit"},{"id":"ABOVE_LIMIT","reasonCode":"LIMIT_REDUCED","then":{"decision":"'COUNTER_OFFER'","maxLimit":"affordableLimit"},"when":"true"}],"version":"1"}

loan_eligibility.v3.stone.json.canonical: {"description":"Unsecured consumer loan eligibility","effectiveFrom":"2026-11-01","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"loan_eligibility","inputs":{"amount":"decimal","applicant":{"age":"int","blacklisted":"bool","monthlyDebt":"decimal","monthlyIncome":"decimal","segment":"string"}},"outputs":{"decision":"string","limit":"decimal"},"rules":[{"description":"Applicants must be adults","id":"R1","reasonCode":"UNDERAGE","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.age < 18"},{"id":"R2","reasonCode":"BLACKLISTED","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.blacklisted"},{"description":"Debt-to-income above 50%","id":"R3","reasonCode":"DTI_HIGH","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.monthlyDebt / applicant.monthlyIncome > decimal('0.5')"},{"description":"Up to 12 months of income, rounded down to the nearest million","id":"R4","then":{"decision":"'APPROVE'","limit":"(applicant.monthlyIncome * 12 / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000"},"when":"amount <= applicant.monthlyIncome * 12"},{"id":"R5","reasonCode":"AMOUNT_ABOVE_LIMIT","then":{"decision":"'REVIEW'"},"when":"true"}],"version":"3"}
